title: Tim Biblical Conversation Attestations — Early 2026
purpose: Preserve dated biblical and Bible-adjacent Tim Dooley material recovered from prior conversations. Exact wording is quoted only when already preserved in repository recovery records; summaries are not quotations.
epistemic_boundary: These records document project statements and comparisons; they do not independently verify supernatural identity or prophecy fulfillment.
